name: swarm-chasing
description: Tools for investigating multi-agent swarms: an MCP server over swarm datasets (AI Village, git, wikis) plus hooks that record your own Claude Code sessions and subagents into it as they run.

data_dir.title: Swarm datasets folder
data_dir.description: Folder holding datasets for the analysis modules (ai-village/, <dataset>/repos/, wiki .db files). A relative path is resolved against the project you run Claude Code in. Live session recording works without it.
